Team —

We have a tentative feature freeze target of 2026-06-10 for the Acme Health integration. Before we lock that, I want to align on three asks so we can finalize the release timing and enablement plan: 

1) Rollout cadence (canary -> staged -> global): proposed 1%, 10%, 50% over 2 weeks. Can Marcus confirm whether the serving runtime has the capacity to sustain 1% steady-state plus bursts during the canary window?

2) Exception paths / rollback triggers: we need a clear list of automatic triggers (latency p95 > 800ms for 10m, error-rate > 1%, quality regression on eval_set) and manual rollback ownership. Who will be the owner on-call during the 2-week ramp?

3) Enablement & docs: Marissa, can you confirm owners for the public runbook, troubleshooting playbook, and the customer-facing configuration guide? We should also lock training slots for Acme CS and Solutions on the week of 2026-06-21.

I've attached a draft runbook and a tentative enablement schedule. Please reply with owners and any redlines by COB Monday (2026-05-24).

Thanks,
Nikhil
